metadata.scenario_name: Emergency Reroute: Catastrophic Ice Shelf Calving & Direct Channel Blockade
metadata.data_sources: RADARSAT Constellation Mission, TerraSAR-X, Indian Antarctic Expedition Maitri Base Radar

voyage_info.ice_conditions: Emergency: Massive calving of Lazarev / Riiser-Larsen ice shelf front; 0-20°E locked in impassable iceberg melange
voyage_info.active_scenario_alert: CRITICAL EMERGENCY - Direct approach corridors to Maitri (0-20°E) completely blocked by calved iceberg barrier. Routes B and C unnavigable.

emergency_event.event_type: Major Ice Shelf Calving & Fast-Ice Breakup
emergency_event.affected_sector: 70°S to 68°S, 0°E to 20°E (Princess Astrid Coast / Lazarev Ice Shelf)
emergency_event.debris_characterization: Over 60 tabular berg fragments, heavy growler fields, and compressional stamukhi ridges up to 12m thick

navigational_status.route_b: BLOCKED - Impassable wall of grounded tabular icebergs. Severe hull breach hazard.
navigational_status.route_c: BLOCKED - Heavy stamukhi pressure ridge closed off fast ice lead at 11°E.
navigational_status.route_a: ONLY VIABLE ROUTE - Extended eastern hook around calving field via 22-26°E with designated icebreaker rendezvous.

icebreaker_escort.escort_vessel: Polar Icebreaker I/B Krasin / SA Agulhas II support
icebreaker_escort.escort_protocol: Escort vessel carves channel through 8/10 consolidated floes into sheltered fast-ice staging bay

routes.name: Eastern Ice-Avoidance Route (Extended Icebreaker Escort)
routes.description: The only safe and viable expedition route. Loops far east around the 0-20°E calving field, meeting an icebreaker escort at 68.5°S, 22.0°E for the final 150 km convoy.
key_features: Sole navigable route into Maitri following the catastrophic calving event
Extended eastern hook adds +550 km and 2 days voyage time
Mandatory icebreaker rendezvous at 68.5°S, 22.0°E for the final 150 km passage
Safe 18% risk score under escort convoy protocol

waypoints.label: Outer Pack Ice Edge (East of Calving Hazard)
ICEBREAKER RENDEZVOUS WAYPOINT (Escort Begin)
waypoints.notes: Convoy formation with heavy polar icebreaker

waypoints.label: Escorted Channel Transit Through Fast Ice
waypoints.notes: Speed controlled to 6 knots behind lead vessel

waypoints.label: Maitri Station Emergency Discharge Berth - ARRIVAL
waypoints.notes: Secured to consolidated fast ice barrier

routes.name: Direct Southern Route [BLOCKED - IMPASSABLE]
routes.description: ROUTE CANCELLED. Direct track into Princess Astrid Coast is completely barred by grounded tabular berg field and pressure ridges. Navigation strictly prohibited.
key_features: 100% BLOCKED by catastrophic calving barrier at 70°S, 11-15°E
Risk score 98% (catastrophic hull rupture / besetting guaranteed)
Passage revoked by Indian Antarctic Expedition Maritime Authority
Vessels must divert to Route A

waypoints.label: TERMINATION POINT - BLOCKED BY ICEBERG WALL

routes.name: Current-Assisted Western Route [BLOCKED - IMPASSABLE]
routes.description: ROUTE CANCELLED. The western channel along the 11°E meridian is locked in compressed multi-year fast-ice stamukhi ridges. Non-navigable.
key_features: Western entrance channel at 68-70°S locked by compressional stamukhi ridges
Risk score 95% (severe besetting risk, zero escape leads)
Master ordered to abort western course
Must divert east to rendezvous with icebreaker escort

waypoints.label: TERMINATION POINT - FAST-ICE STAMUKHI BLOCKADE
waypoints.notes: No navigable leads into Maitri from western flank
